title: Brazilian Yeast Bread
description: A delicious Brazilian-style bread made with yeast and topped with peas
instructions: 1. In a large mixing bowl, combine yeast and warm water.
2. Let the mixture sit for 5 minutes.
3. Add the flour, sugar, and curry powder to the bowl.
6. Place the dough in a greased bowl and let it rise for 1 hour.
8. Punch down the dough and shape it into a loaf.
9. Place the loaf on a baking sheet and bake for 30-40 minutes.
10. Remove the bread from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes.
11. Top the bread with peas and serve.
